explication: Novu is communication infrastructure for product notifications and agent conversations. The principal ACI flow receives channel messages, normalizes and routes them to an existing agent, then delivers the agent’s reply back through a channel. The README also documents product notification workflows, digests, an embeddable Inbox and preferences, and broad channel/provider support; those capabilities are represented at the documented subsystem level where this tree excerpt does not expose implementation files. The sampled sources show controller-to-use-case invocation, but not the full runtime wiring, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
